text:
POV: your agent has been running clean for three hours. You get up for coffee. Somewhere in minute five, a tool call comes back 429.
The retry wrapper you wrote at midnight swallows it, returns None, and None passes every check downstream because nothing expected a tool to answer with nothing.
You come back to a task marked complete. The output file is empty. The log is green.
The fix is four lines. Finding it cost you an afternoon and a little faith in green logs.
